messages:
dylan: quick pitch: add 'tracelets' to onboarding. tiny deterministic traces to exercise tokenization, kv-cache, attention edgecases.
riya: how do these differ from golden samples / mini-bench?
kevin: golden checks output, mini-bench is perf. tracelets are unit-like sequences focused on runtime artifacts (token alignment, kv rotation, small latency).
sarah: useful for catching kv-cache evictions and off-by-one tokenization.
dylan: cheap to run at admit + canary, helps isolate runtime vs model weight regressions.
matt: manifest change? ship tracelets with model descriptor?
kevin: yes. example manifest snippet: `tracelets: [{id:kv-rot, seq:["A","B"], assert:"tokens,kv_ok", max_latency_ms:50}]`.
riya: limit asserts to structural/numeric checks, no brittle full-text equality.
sarah: trust model: mark tracelets verified|unverified. run unverified only in isolated smokehouse.
dylan: default unverified. verified tracelets can run in fast admit path.
bench-bot: queued: running foo/v2 tracelets on canary in 10m.
matt: storage for results? console diffs needed.
kevin: store compact run summary in registry (pass/fail, p50/p99, kv-checksum), keep full logs 7d.
riya: runtime upgrade policy: run tracelets during kernel/runtime upgrades on Dedicated to catch infra regressions.
sarah: downside: flaky asserts -> noise.
dylan: mitigation: assertion confidence + rerun threshold (default n=3).
matt: provide `runtest tracelet <model> --local` for repro.
kevin: integrate with smokehouse runner to reuse infra.
riya: blockers: manifest schema update, verifier, docs, console UX.
dylan: i'll draft RFC follow-up covering manifest, allowed asserts, run semantics, storage. aim EOD.
sarah: add auto-fallback: if a verified tracelet fails on canary, fallback to previous runtime/kernel.
dylan: noted. bench-bot please post results back.
bench-bot: run started; will post summary in thread when done.
